title: This is designed as an Infrastructure-layer swap: because Domain code only ever…
description: This is designed as an Infrastructure-layer swap: because Domain code only ever "raises an event" through an abstraction, and never depends on how that event is delivered, moving from in-process to broker-based delivery does not require changing any Domain or Application code that raises or handles events — only the dispatch mechanism underneath.

source.quote: This is designed as an Infrastructure-layer swap: because Domain code only ever "raises an event" through an abstraction, and never depends on how that event is delivered, moving from in-process to broker-based delivery does not require changing any Domain or Application code that raises or handles events — only the dispatch mechanism underneath.
